meta.title: Tech+RFQ project (RFQ stage): counter offer accepted and used in the award
gaps: Close the prepared live event so that awarding becomes available
Start Awarding and award the event to Vendor A after the event closes
Verify that the submitted award uses the accepted 90 bid
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Close the prepared live event so that awarding becomes available; Start Awarding and award the event to Vendor A after the event closes; Verify that the submitted award uses the accepted 90 bid

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event on the RFQ Responses screen, which is the required starting point for this state.
Send a counter offer of 90 on the invited vendor's own normal bid.
Verify the buyer's Responses grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Switch to the configured vendor portal and have Vendor A accept the pending counter offer.
Verify the buyer's Responses grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as accepted.
Open Master QCS to inspect the accepted bid value.
Verify Master QCS shows the accepted RFQ rate as 90 for Vendor A.
